_about: Symposium decks sent to VGR directly rather than uploaded to the Drive folder (session 61).
Keyed by a stable id (rcv_ + a short name) that stands in for a Drive file id in the deck
state, the vector ids and the archive manifest. The files live in sources/symposium/received/,
which is gitignored (originals can carry contact slides), so they exist on the laptop only:
the VM's weekly deck sync skips an entry whose file it cannot see, and never prunes it.
sync_symposium_decks.py embeds them like Drive files; archive_symposium.py builds their PDFs.
If a speaker later puts the same deck on the Drive, delete the entry here so it is not doubled.
